Messages.Author: Petri Wessman
Messages.Body:
Fortune Teller says "you may look at one card picked at random from
your prey's hand.". If you have two (or more) FT's, is each "look" a
separate random event, or are they combined? In other words, do I
pick one, look at it, and give it back (to be reshuffled into his
hand), or do I just pick 2 random cards and look at it?

//Petri

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


"You may look at one card picked at random".
You may do this two times.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <7xg0stm...@termiitti.akumiitti.fi>, Petri Wessman
<or...@termiitti.akumiitti.fi> writes

>Fortune Teller says "you may look at one card picked at random from
>your prey's hand.". If you have two (or more) FT's, is each "look" a
>separate random event, or are they combined?

They're separate.

>In other words, do I
>pick one, look at it, and give it back (to be reshuffled into his
>hand), or do I just pick 2 random cards and look at it?

You look at one, give it back, shuffle his hand (if he wants, I guess)
and then you pick another. So yes, you could end up seeing that same
single copy of Archon Investigation twice.
